headline: Reliance Jio Prepares for Market Debut Following Record-Setting India IPO
summary: Mukesh Ambani's telecommunications unit Jio is set to make its trading debut on Indian stock exchanges after its record public offering saw bids for more than 22 times the shares available.
why: Jio is India's leading digital and mobile network operator, making its public listing one of the most consequential capital market events in emerging market equities.

impacts.name: Reliance Industries Limited
impacts.why: Massive institutional demand for Jio's float unlocks significant shareholder value for its parent conglomerate.
